high-error-rate.title: Check recent deployments — correlate error spike with deploy time
Review application logs for new exception patterns
Roll back last deployment if correlated
Verify external dependencies (DB, cache, APIs) are healthy

timeout-burst.title: Check connection pool utilization and thread saturation
Identify slow downstream calls via distributed traces
Enable circuit breaker with 50% failure rate threshold
Scale up instances or increase connection pool size

service-down.title: Check container/pod status — look for OOMKilled, CrashLoopBackOff
Review CPU, memory, and disk before the failure
Restart service via orchestrator (kubectl rollout restart)
Verify node health, storage availability, network reachability

latency-anomaly.title: Check CPU utilization — sustained >80% causes latency spikes
Review GC pause times and memory pressure
Check if latency is across all endpoints or specific paths
Add instances to distribute load if CPU saturated

cascading-failure.title: Follow dependency graph to find deepest failing node — fix there first
Add timeout + circuit breaker to contain blast radius
Temporarily disable or mock the failing dependency
Watch upstream services recover as root dependency stabilizes

connection-refused.title: Verify DNS resolution and network connectivity
Check security groups, firewall rules, service mesh config
Run direct connectivity test (curl, nc, telnet)
Fix network/config issue and re-deploy if needed

transient-error.title: Monitor — low error rate, likely self-healing. Set alert for >50% in 5 min
Verify retries are succeeding in logs
Confirm error rate stays below 5% for 10 minutes

5xx.title: Roll back if deployment is correlated
